description: This file defines a React component 'AnnotationLayerControl' for managing annotation layers in a visualization, including UI rendering, state management, and Redux integration.

classes.name: AnnotationLayerControl
classes.description: React component for controlling annotation layers, including adding, editing, removing, and rendering annotation layers with popovers and Redux state management.

methods.name: addAnnotationLayer
methods.description: Adds or updates an annotation layer, triggers data refresh, and updates parent component.

methods.name: removeAnnotationLayer
methods.description: Removes an annotation layer and adjusts UI scroll behavior.

methods.name: handleVisibleChange
methods.description: Handles visibility toggling of popover UI elements.

methods.name: renderPopover
methods.description: Renders the content of annotation layer popovers.

methods.name: renderInfo
methods.description: Displays status icons or error messages for annotations.
